item.title: China busts cross-border blood smuggling ring over biosecurity fears
item.description: China has cracked down on the smuggling of blood samples from pregnant women, highlighting what authorities describe as a threat to national biosecurity. State broadcaster CCTV reported on Wednesday that Shenzhen Customs anti-smuggling officers had dismantled an underground network that illegally collected and transported the blood out of mainland China.
